programme.title: E4 - Ice
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: E1 - Humpback Birth of a Giant
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: E3 - Heat
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.desc: Follow an injured opossum into surgery, as the medical team realizes amputation may be the only way to save his badly injured toe. And meet some turtle hatchlings who seem ready for release when the team gets disappointing details about their size.

programme.title: E3 - Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist

programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies’ lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies’ first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park’s main attraction.

programme.title: E42
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: E30
programme.desc: 朱韻剛開始大學生活，就被“壞小子”李峋的闖入徹底顛覆了世界。被朱韻當成不學無術富家子的他，真實身份竟是學校破格錄取的特招生，難得一見的編程天才。兩人在幾次交鋒後，對彼此都有些賞識。學長方志靖對朱韻多次刁難，李峋出手維護朱韻，還邀她加入了自己組建的備賽隊伍，代表學校贏得了重大編程比賽。在相處中，兩人情感日益升溫

programme.title: E34

E1 - From Dinosaurs To Pet Knights!
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak & pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags & even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor—who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: E2 - From Mail To Outer Space!
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big & small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi’s mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity & performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: E12
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。

programme.desc: 擁有一頭白色頭髮、不老容貌，被譽為傳奇談判專家的尹洙諾，開始了一場高風險的併購談判，拯救一度拋棄過他的公司 HM 集團。擁有精英團隊的專業人士－包括頂尖律師、會計師、行銷專家和專利專家律師的尹洙諾，利用自己無與倫比的技能去講述企業間併購的故事。

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相。
